summary: Tested Job Matching endpoints and UI. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Fixed 2 frontend bugs: 1) 'Rechercher avec scoring' button error when filters.secteur.value was already an array (from saved preferences), 2) loadApplications error when API returns {applications: [...]} instead of array. France Travail button working correctly with real API data.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/jobs/matching returns correct format: {has_data, has_filters, profile_summary, matches}
GET /api/jobs/matching profile_summary has correct structure (titre, skills_count, has_optimized_cv, has_career_project)
GET /api/jobs/matching match entries have correct structure (titre, matching_score, secteur, type_contrat, scoring=null)
POST /api/jobs/matching/search returns matches with scoring object (statut, score_detail, evaluations, blocages, vigilances, points_forts)
POST /api/jobs/matching/search scoring.statut has valid values (Excellent match, Match pertinent, Match moyen, Faible compatibilité, Incompatible)
POST /api/jobs/france-travail/search match entries have correct structure
frontend_ui_tests: 'Offres / Matching' tab shows job cards with matching scores (67%, 64%)
France Travail section visible with department input (default: 75)
France Travail button 'Offres France Travail' visible and clickable
Filter panel opens when clicking 'Filtres de recherche'
Filter inputs work (metier, zone_geographique, contrat type)
'Rechercher avec scoring' button works after fix - returns scored results
Scoring badges displayed on job cards (Match moyen, Localisation, etc.)
Vigilance warnings displayed (Localisation hors zone demandée)
France Travail search returns 20 real job offers from API
France Travail results show matching scores and job details

bugs_fixed.issue: buildSearchPayload() called .split() on filters.metier.value and filters.secteur.value which could already be arrays when loaded from saved preferences
loadApplications() expected res.data to be an array but API returns {applications: [...], total: ...}
bugs_fixed.fix: Added check for both array and object response formats

critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints correctly implemented: GET /jobs/matching (line 974), POST /jobs/matching/search (line 1027), GET /jobs/matching/preferences (line 7353), POST /jobs/france-travail/search (line 7373)
France Travail API integration working with real data from francetravail.io
Scoring system correctly calculates evaluations, blocages, vigilances, and points_forts based on filter priorities

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All features verified and working after fixes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Job Matching feature fully tested and working. Two frontend bugs were fixed: 1) buildSearchPayload() now handles both string and array values for metier/secteur filters, 2) loadApplications() now handles both array and {applications: [...]} response formats. France Travail API is working with real job data. All 4 backend endpoints tested: GET /jobs/matching, POST /jobs/matching/search, GET /jobs/matching/preferences, POST /jobs/france-travail/search.

france_travail_search.matches: [20 real France Travail job offers with matching_score, titre, entreprise, localisation, type_contrat, salaire]
